items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Basie sent and got Walter Page and Joe Jones, and that's how I got into Basie's band, through recommendation from Joe Jones and Walter Page

ctx.x: The piano player? Yeah. Good piano player. And then Jimmy Miller was the guitar player at the time, and Catherine, they were still married, she was dancing in this club called The Plantation. And in St. Louis, we all left Cleveland to go to work there at the Plantation. And

Catherine and Jimmy, they divorced and she went back East. And Jimmy Blanton joined Duke and Basie sent and got Walter Page and Joe Jones, and that's how I got into Basie's band, through recommendation from Joe Jones and Walter Page, when I got to New York.
Oh, I always sort of wondered.
